en.headline: ReThink HK sustainability conference opens at Convention Centre
en.dek: The two-day event at Hall 1 of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre brings together business, government and NGO leaders on climate action and sustainable solutions through Friday.
body: ReThink HK 2026, Asia’s flagship climate-action and sustainable-business event, opened on Thursday at Hall 1 of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre and runs through Friday.

Organised with the Business Environment Council, the seventh edition is structured around thematic zones covering cities, energy, impact, innovation and resources. Organisers expect more than 10,000 attendees, hundreds of speakers and over 300 exhibitors presenting practical solutions for net-zero and circular-economy goals.

Under Secretary for Environment and Ecology Diane Wong delivered the opening address, outlining the city’s latest sustainability priorities. The programme includes keynotes, roundtables and an expo open to registered professional delegates.

zh.headline: ReThink HK可持續發展博覽會於會展開幕
zh.dek: 為期兩日的亞洲氣候行動與可持續商業活動在灣仔會展1號館舉行，匯聚商界、政府及非政府機構代表至周五。
body: 亞洲具代表性的氣候行動與可持續商業活動ReThink HK 2026周四在香港會議展覽中心1號展覽廳開幕，活動持續至周五。
本屆與商界環保協會合辦，設有低碳城市、能源轉型、實踐探索、創新科技及資源循環等主題展區，預計吸引逾一萬名參加者、數百名講者及逾300家參展商，展示淨零及循環經濟實務方案。
環境及生態局副局長黃淑嫻主持開幕致辭，介紹本港最新可持續發展重點。活動包括主題演講、圓桌討論及專業人士展覽。
